# Aura — full catalog

> Ambient gradient backgrounds, free and open source.

Aura is a catalog of hand-tuned ambient and mesh gradient backgrounds. Every
gradient is built from layered CSS gradients combined with blend modes and
blur, and can be exported as CSS variables or standalone SVG/PNG, or
customized live in the built-in editor. The whole project is MIT licensed and
available on GitHub at https://github.com/CristianOlivera1/Aura.

## Gradient catalog

Total gradients: 82.

## Technical notes

- Each gradient has 2-4 CSS layers (linear/radial/conic gradients) combined
  with blend modes such as screen, overlay, hard-light, soft-light, multiply,
  color-dodge and difference.
- Layers can be reordered and re-tuned (blur 0-100px, opacity 0-100%, blend
  mode) in the visual editor at https://auragradients.vercel.app/.
- Exports: CSS gradient code or SVG; PNG download at 1600x1000.
- The theme is adaptive: each gradient declares a preferred light or dark
  background; visitors can override it with a manual toggle.

## Usage

Free, open source (MIT). Drop the CSS/SVG output behind any interface for a
soft atmospheric background. Attribution appreciated but not required.

- [GitHub source](https://github.com/CristianOlivera1/Aura).
